description: An internal component, exported by no entrypoint, its decorator written behind a block comment on the same line, which prettier keeps. ngc compiles it (measured through ngc in partial mode and the linker for `check-parts`); the pattern wants the decorator in column zero, and the counter that stood beside it wanted it at the start of a line past indentation, so neither saw it, and the text its template prints passed every point. The parser counts it, and point 1 names it by file and line.
